name: Arnav Angarkar
description:
Arnav is a CS student at IIIT Dharwad and an open-source developer who likes building things at the intersection of software, AI, and the real world.

He works across the FOSSASIA ecosystem, contributing to projects including VoxBento, Eventyay and its plugins. His work ranges from web platforms and developer infrastructure to real-time streaming, AI transcription, and WebRTC.

He enjoys jumping between projects, picking up unfamiliar technologies, and turning messy engineering problems into systems that actually work. He is particularly interested in open-source software, AI, and building practical technology that people can use.

When he isn't debugging something, he is probably starting another project.
